description: Creates and sends a push notification on the current site. Required fields: title, message, url. Do not add optional fields (tags, image_url, utm_params, audience_groups, actions, etc.) unless the user explicitly asks for them — for example, do not infer tags from the notification topic. Delivery modes (mutually exclusive — pick AT MOST one): (a) status="schedule" + schedule_date for a one-shot scheduled send; (b) pass recurring_schedule { days, times, start_date, end_date } for a recurring/repeating notification — leave status at "sent" (default) to activate the recurrence, or use "draft" to save without activating; (c) when scheduling one-shot, optionally pass send_in_subscribers_timezone=true to deliver at the scheduled wall-clock time in each subscriber's local timezone (only when the user explicitly asks, e.g. "send at 9am in their timezone"). Otherwise the notification is sent immediately. Use status="draft" to save without sending or activating. Audience: by default sends to all subscribers. Pass `audience_groups` (array of 1-20 predefined audience-group IDs) only when the user mentions a saved/predefined audience group. When the user asks to use the site URL, call pushengage_list_sites and use the current site's site_url.

actions.description: Action buttons. Only when the user explicitly asks.

android_push.description: Android-specific options. Requires channel_id when set. Only when the user explicitly asks.

audience_groups.description: Send to one or more predefined audience groups (1-20 group IDs). Each ID refers to an audience group already configured in PushEngage. Omit this field to send to all subscribers. Only set this when the user mentions a saved/predefined audience group.

big_image_url.description: Large hero image. Only when the user explicitly asks for a big image.

expire_in.description: Expiry in seconds (60–2419200). Only when the user explicitly asks.

image_url.description: Small notification icon. Only when the user explicitly asks for an image.

ios_push.description: iOS-specific options. Only when the user explicitly asks.

recurring_schedule.description: OPTIONAL. Turns this into a recurring notification that fires on the chosen days/times between start_date and end_date. Mutually exclusive with status="schedule", schedule_date, and send_in_subscribers_timezone. With recurring_schedule set, leave status at "sent" (default) to activate the recurrence, or use "draft" to save without activating. Only set this when the user explicitly asks for a recurring/repeating notification.

days.description: Days of the week to send on. Values are lowercase day names. At least one day required.

end_date.description: Last date the recurrence is active. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or after start_date.

start_date.description: First date the recurrence is active. Format: YYYY-MM-DD (site timezone).

times.description: Times of day to send (24-hour). HH:mm or HH:mm:ss accepted. e.g. ["09:00", "17:30"]. At least one, up to 100.

schedule_date.description: Required when status is "schedule". Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss in the site timezone.

send_in_subscribers_timezone.description: Only valid when status="schedule" (and not combined with recurring_schedule). When true, schedule_date is interpreted in each subscriber's local timezone instead of the site timezone — one delivery is scheduled per subscriber timezone so every recipient receives the push at the same wall-clock time. Only set this when the user explicitly asks for subscriber-timezone delivery (for example: "send at 9am in their timezone").

status.description: Send now (sent), schedule for later (schedule), or save without sending (draft)

tags.description: Up to 5 tags, 36 chars each. Only when the user explicitly asks for tags.

url.description: Destination URL when the subscriber clicks the notification

utm_params.description: UTM tracking params. Only when the user explicitly asks.

name: pushengage_send_notification
title: Send a push notification
